notes.title: V1.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players,
We have addressed the various bugs that emerged after the game's launch with the following updates. You can visit STEAM to automatically install the new version![/h3]

Here are the updates included in V1.1:
1、Fixed the issue where subtitles were not displaying correctly.
2、Resolved the issue of some players' save files being lost.
3、Repaired the failure of the online connectivity feature.
4、Fixed the occasional black screen and crash issue.
5、Addressed the issue where achievements were not being recorded.
6、Corrected the error in the affection points increase for Jingrui Cao's storyline.
7、Repaired the issue where videos in the Mikami_Kana Photo Gallery could not be unlocked; they can now be unlocked again after completing the final storyline.
8、Fixed the display anomaly for the female protagonist's age.

If you have any issues, please provide feedback on the STEAM community and our DISCORD:[url=https://discord.gg/AeqAV8jQk7]Drive me crazy[/url].
Thank you once again for your support!

notes.title: Apology Letter for 'Drive Me Crazy'
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This is the production team of "Drive Me Crazy." Since the game's initial launch, we are extremely grateful for the continuous support from our players!

On the first day of the game's launch, we have received feedback and suggestions about the game, and we sincerely thank you all once again! We also apologize for any dissatisfaction with the current version and will address some of the main concerns here.

[u][b]Regarding the role of Mikami_Yua in the game:[/b][/u]
Throughout the game's process, Yua plays a role in advancing the main storyline, appearing at the beginning, middle, and end of the game. Other characters belong to side stories that can be explored, and Yua also participates in some interactions within these stories. For example, in Siyu An's part, there is a plot where Yua suddenly comes home; depending on the choices made, the duration of the scenes in Yua's storyline may vary, so we recommend experiencing a chapter with different choices to discover new elements. Yua's overall screen time will not be less than that of any other female character in the game.

[u][b]Regarding various game bugs:[/b][/u]
Since the launch, we have received many bug reports and game suggestions from players, and we are very grateful. We deeply apologize for the poor gaming experience caused by the current version. We will not abandon the project and hope to continue to improve and refine "Drive Me Crazy" under the supervision of our players.

Font loss: The new version has already fixed this issue, and you can update directly.
Black screen for some players + unable to continue the game: You can provide your device model to us, and we will investigate and fix it.
Network connection issues: You can use an accelerator or change the network environment. We will optimize the network environment in the future to enhance the experience.
Save file loss: After updating, there may be a problem with save file loss, and we will urgently fix it.

We will gradually fix the existing bugs according to priority in the near future.

Once again, thank you for your love and attention. We will also soon release our first [free DLC] and [4K high-definition DLC].

We will reduce the difficulty of the existing photo gallery content and add 100% more progress to the photo videos (additional videos will be added to the package after some time).

We hope you can point out and tolerate our shortcomings, and we hope you can continue to experience the game. If your previous experience has changed, we hope you can leave us an appropriate review again, which is very important to us! Thank you for your support once again!

The "Drive Me Crazy" Production Team
July 13, 2024

notes.title: "Drive Me Crazy" is officially on sale now!
notes.content:
The interactive film game of love genre "Drive Me Crazy," starring Mikami_Yua, has been officially released!

The game's first launch platform is STEAM, and it will also be launched on consoles, mobile devices, and mini-programs later. The initial version adds 10 female protagonists, 8 of which can be pursued. The complete chapters of the other 2 female protagonists will also be given to everyone as a free DLC in the future!

On the day before taking wedding photos with Mikami_Kana, the protagonist Qiangzi actually lost his wedding ring at the bachelor party! With some familiar items that evoke memories, Qiangzi also has entanglements with 7 other girls, and Mikami's only request is for Qiangzi to find the ring.
The game adopts a non-linear narrative method, using the technique of interspersed memories and reality to tell the story of Qiangzi and these girls, and integrates various mini-games to increase the fun! As for Qiangzi's final choice, it's up to you!

[b][u]The game is priced at $12.99, with a 10% discount on the initial launch, making the promotional price $11.69, which will last for two weeks.[/u][/b]

If you have some feelings and suggestions during the game, you are welcome to discuss in the community ~ If you think the game is very good, you can leave us a recommendation comment! Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: "Drive Me Crazy" is scheduled for release on July 12th, UTC-8 (Friday)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the production team of "Drive Me Crazy." We are very grateful for your continued attention to the game. Since the postponement of the release, we have received a lot of attention from many players and media friends. Thank you again for your support and encouragement!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45056483/36c9abcc74d62f47388723b8e504134739d407ca.jpg[/img]

After the page was announced, with everyone's support, we also had the opportunity to be officially recommended in the STEAM "Coming Soon" section!

We have decided to release the game immediately after the STEAM summer game sale event. [u][b]The game is scheduled to officially launch on STEAM on July 12, 2024, at UTC-8![/b][/u]

We welcome everyone to add the game to their wishlist. The first DLC after the game goes online, we will also give it to everyone for free as promised, let's go crazy for love this summer~

"Drive Me Crazy" is a real-life love interactive film game. In the game, the player plays the role of "Qiangzi," who accidentally lost his wedding ring at the bachelor party on the eve of his marriage. At the same time, some familiar items begin to appear, and some dusty memories are awakened with a series of phone calls. What's even more unexpected is that Qiangzi has entanglements with a rich first love, a popular female idol, a sexy pet doctor, a famous football commentator, a sickly Chinese-style girl, a wealthy female boss, and a rock 'n' roll motorcycle girl! The only demand from his fiancée, Miakmi, is for Qiangzi to find the ring!

The game uses a non-linear narrative technique, with 10 characters, 8 of which are main characters that can be pursued. Each character has had a special relationship with Qiangzi in the past. The game has also added 8 addictive mini-game play methods, with simple operation and difficulty, and the different game results of the players will also affect the direction of the plot!

If you are interested in the game, search for "Drive Me Crazy" on STEAM, and welcome to add the game to your wishlist. You can also join our DISCORD: [url=https://discord.gg/AeqAV8jQk7]Drive Me Crazy[/url] to communicate and discuss the game together!

notes.title: Announcement of the Postponed Release of 'Drive Me Crazy'
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are the production team behind "Drive Me Crazy." Since the announcement of our game, we have received a lot of attention and support from players, media, and industry friends. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you here!

During this period, we have also received valuable feedback from various parties. The originally scheduled release date of July 3rd coincides with the Steam Summer Sale, which means we would not be able to benefit from the official traffic support.

We hope that our game can be seen and loved by more Steam users, to live up to the players who have been supporting us all along, and to honor the efforts of all the actors, crew members, and development team who have worked on this project for a long time. [b][u]We have decided to postpone the release of the game until after the summer sale![/u][/b]

We are grateful for the valuable suggestions provided by Steam.

During the extension period, we will not stop our steps. We will continue to refine the game to ensure that it provides the best experience for everyone after its release.

Once again, we thank you all for your support and understanding! We also apologize for this delay. [b][u]We have decided to offer the first DLC of the game for free as a token of our appreciation! [/u][/b]Let this summer be filled with passion and may it evoke or bring you precious memories.
